basic_info.description: The complete package in the heart of Bernal Heights! This three bedroom home has been completely rebuilt and re-designed. It features an open and spacious floorplan with a chef's kitchen featuring new, high quality appliances. There are three full baths in the home as well as a wonderfully serene outdoor setting in an exceptional large space not often seen in Bernal. The main level has striking solid oak floors and high ceilings, creating a feeling of warmth and comfort.  Bernal's well known for plenty of sunshine and natural light fills this home through windows on three sides. The main en-suite bedroom on the upper level complements the living area. Thoughtful design takes advantage of the outdoor space in the rear of the home. A large deck off the kitchen has steps down to the yard and patio. The lower level has two bedrooms and two baths with a sliding door from the lower en-suite bedroom which leads to the rear yard. A gated breezeway provides exterior access to the back of the home as well. Modern conveniences like the EV charger in the garage and all-in-one washer dryer create an urban oasis just steps from Cortland's bustling shops, restaurants, recreation center, playground and library. 372 Moultrie is the perfect City retreat!
